_comment: IH35-TMS · ECONOMIC VERIFICATION COLUMNS C25-C31. Canonical proves/evidence/auto_check/fail_is_unique (owner-ratified 2026-08-30). Merge into columns.shared.json keeping short header labels. Board MUST consume these fields. A miss with fail_is_unique:true is HTTP-500 severity. Chrome walks and ledger prose cannot satisfy these columns.
_rationale: accounting was stamped 14/14 CERTIFIED and 39-of-39 while INV-2026-00037/00044/00045 sat marked PAID with no invoice-sourced GL. Under C01-C24 that is a legitimate PASS. It is a FAIL under C25.

columns.label: GL delta matches posting matrix
columns.proves: The journal entry this leaf produced hits the EXACT accounts and signs the posting matrix specifies for this transaction type. Balanced is not correct — DR Unbilled / CR Revenue balances and is wrong for an issued invoice.
columns.evidence: Neon: the JE's account_number + debit_or_credit per line, compared to the signed posting matrix row.

columns.label: Subledger ties to control account
columns.proves: After this leaf's action the module's subledger still equals its GL control account, to the cent.
columns.evidence: INV-3 in scripts/verify-gl-invariants.sql — ar_difference = 0.00 AND ap_difference = 0.00.

columns.label: No stranded intermediate
columns.proves: Every downstream leg fired. invoice -> A/R -> cash. bill -> A/P -> payment. settlement -> liability -> cash. Nothing left parked in Unbilled Revenue, Undeposited Funds or Cash Clearing.
columns.evidence: INV-6 — those three system_purpose accounts net to 0.00 for closed documents.

columns.label: Void produces a linked equal-and-opposite entry
columns.proves: Voiding produces a reversing JE linked by reverses_je_id / reversed_by_je_id, net GL effect returns to zero, and no JE is ever voided in place.
columns.evidence: INV-11 — je_voided_in_place = 0 and the two link counts match.

columns.label: Respects period lock and date policy
columns.proves: The entry cannot post into a closed period, and cannot be dated beyond the approved future horizon.
columns.evidence: INV-8 + INV-9 — at least one period closed with a lock date; future_dated = 0.

columns.label: Entity-pure posting and live role bindings
columns.proves: The posting used ONLY accounts belonging to this operating_company_id, AND every chart_of_accounts_role its poster resolves is active in THIS entity. A TRANSP or TRK pass never satisfies this for USMCA.
columns.evidence: INV-10b/10c — no role required by an enabled posting flag is inactive or duplicate-order-dependent in this entity.

columns.label: Proven against a living document
columns.proves: Certified against at least one real, non-voided, non-sample document. An honest-empty render is a valid FIRST test and is never sufficient alone.
columns.evidence: The row id of the living document, plus its GL entry id. 'honest empty' alone = UNVERIFIED, not PASS.

law_amendments_required: CREATE-TEST-THEN-VOID: keep TEST rows; exclude is_sample_data from financial reports immediately.
VERTICAL-WIRING-LAW: fix horizontally at the mechanism, verify vertically along the money lifecycle.
Branch protection this week before CC-1 A/R merge.
